content.rationale: Bracketing discards the undone tail — keeps markers[..pos] — then appends the operation's kind, the change it targeted and its kept entry ids in run order and sets the position to the new length (kpptprql). The bracket supersedes the undone work: a later redo has nothing left to redo, and a later undo starts its walk at the new end. Only mutating operations bracket because only bracket writes markers, and undo and redo have no capture path by construction.
